prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1011; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Inspection of the vehicle shows scraping and paint transfer along the right rear quarter panel, a cracked rear bumper cover end, and a dented, scuffed right rear door, all consistent with a sideswipe while changing lanes. The damage pattern lines up with the impact as described. The proposed repair plan covers replacing the bumper cover, repairing and refinishing the door and quarter panel, and blending adjacent paint. The labor hours requested fit the extent of the damage. The shop's invoices show no repeated charges. Nothing in the file suggests earlier damage to this vehicle in the same area.
